Who is this for?+

B2B exhibitors with a paid booth at a named trade show, a clear buyer profile, and an approval owner. We agree timing and a feasible scope before starting.

What do you need from our team?+

Your show and booth details, priority products, buyer profile, exclusions, an approval owner, and an authorised sender. For the show itself, we agree a way to share usable conversation notes or lead exports.

How is the engagement priced?+

One exhibitor and one named show. We quote after understanding the timing, workload, and follow-up window. Scope, milestones, and terms are agreed in writing.
